def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

import json
def transform(g):
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cols=sorted(c)
    mino=[x for x in cols if c[x]==min(c.values())][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==mino]
    h=max(p[0] for p in pts)-min(p[0] for p in pts)+1
    w=max(p[1] for p in pts)-min(p[1] for p in pts)+1
    shape={(p[0]-min(p[0] for p in pts),p[1]-min(p[1] for p in pts)) for p in pts}
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for i in range(H-h+1):
        for j in range(W-w+1):
            if all(g[i+a][j+b]==bg for a,b in shape):
                for a,b in shape: out[i+a][j+b]=mino
    return out

from collections import Counter
def shape_of(g):
    c=Counter(v for r in g for v in r); order=[v for v,_ in c.most_common()]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==order[-1]]
    r0,c0=min(p[0] for p in pts),min(p[1] for p in pts)
    return {(p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0) for p in pts}, order
def fits(g,sh,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); h=max(a for a,b in sh)+1; w=max(b for a,b in sh)+1
    return [(i,j) for i in range(H-h+1) for j in range(W-w+1) if all(g[i+a][j+b]==bg for a,b in sh)]
sh,order=shape_of(i2); print(sh,order)

def shape_of(g):
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r)

    mino=order[-1]
    pos=[(i,j) for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,v in enumerate(r) if v==mino]
    r0=min(p[0] for p in pos); c0=min(p[1] for p in pos)
    sh={(i-r0,j-c0) for i,j in pos}

def fits(g,sh,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); h=max(a for a,b in sh)+1; w=max(b for a,b in sh)+1

    g=[r[:] for r in g]
    for i,j in fits(g,sh,order[1]):

demos=[(G['Demo pair %d input'%k],G['Demo pair %d output'%k]) for k in range(1,5)]

def features(g,sh,pos,noise,bg):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); h=max(a for a,b in sh)+1; w=max(b for a,b in sh)+1
    i,j=pos
    S=set(sh)
    bbox=[(a,b) for a in range(h) for b in range(w)]
    per=[(a,b) for a in range(-1,h+1) for b in range(-1,w+1)
         if (a,b) not in bbox and 0<=i+a<H and 0<=j+b<W]
    per_in=[(a,b) for a,b in per]
    f={}
    f['border']= i==0 or j==0 or i+h>=H or j+w>=W
    f['per_noise']= all(g[i+a][j+b]==noise for a,b in per) if per else None
    f['per_noise_frac']= sum(g[i+a][j+b]==noise for a,b in per)/len(per) if per else 1
    # 8-adj neighbors of shape cells (not bbox)
    nb=set()
    for a,b in sh:
        for da in(-1,0,1):
            for db in(-1,0,1):
                c=(a+da,b+db)
                if c not in S and 0<=i+c[0]<H and 0<=j+c[1]<W: nb.add(c)
    f['nb_noise_frac']= sum(g[i+a][j+b]==noise for a,b in nb)/len(nb) if nb else 1
    f['bbox_per_noise']= all(g[i+a][j+b]==noise for a,b in per) if per else None
    return f

# gather demo stamped fits and test fits (bg=1 candidates)

from collections import Counter

def background(grid):
    """The most common color in the grid."""
    return Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

def majority_color(grid, exclude=()):
    """The most common color excluding the given ones."""
    c = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in exclude)
    return c.most_common(1)[0][0]

def rare_color(grid, exclude=()):
    """The least common color excluding the given ones."""
    c = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in exclude)
    return min(c, key=c.get)

def bbox(grid):
    """(top, left, bottom, right) of the non-background cells; None if none."""
    bg = background(grid)
    cells = [(i, j) for i, row in enumerate(grid) for j, v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    if not cells:
        return None
    return (min(i for i, _ in cells), min(j for _, j in cells),
            max(i for i, _ in cells), max(j for _, j in cells))

def full_rows(grid, color):
    """Indices of rows that are entirely the given color."""
    return [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == color for v in row)]

    return [j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if all(row[j] == color for row in grid)]

# Slide the shape so it touches the 2-line from its own side; draw an 8-line along its far edge.
from lib import background, full_rows, full_cols, cells_of, draw_line, blit_color

LINE = 2
MARK = 8

def transform(grid):
    H, W = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = background(grid)
    hr = full_rows(grid, LINE)
    vc = full_cols(grid, LINE)
    sc = ({v for row in grid for v in row} - {LINE, bg}).pop()
    cells = cells_of(grid, sc)
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    out = [[bg] * W for _ in range(H)]
    if hr:
        lr = hr[0]
        below = r0 > lr
        nr0 = lr + 1 if below else lr - (r1 - r0 + 1)
        blit_color(out, cells, nr0 - r0, 0, sc)
        ec = nr0 + (r1 - r0 + 1) if below else nr0 - 1
        draw_line(out, ec, MARK, 'h')
        draw_line(out, lr, LINE, 'h')
    else:
        lc = vc[0]
        right = c0 > lc
        nc0 = lc + 1 if right else lc - (c1 - c0 + 1)
        blit_color(out, cells, 0, nc0 - c0, sc)
        ec = nc0 + (c1 - c0 + 1) if right else nc0 - 1
        draw_line(out, ec, MARK, 'v')
        draw_line(out, lc, LINE, 'v')
    return out

import math

H,W=len(T2),len(T2[0])
sh=sorted(tsh); h=max(a for a,b in sh)+1; w=max(b for a,b in sh)+1

wcells={wp:{(i+a,j+b) for a,b in sh} for wp,(i,j) in [(w,(w[0],w[1])) for w in windows]}
F=[(9,17),(10,16),(11,2),(12,22),(14,24)]
Fset=set(F)
Fc={f:wcells[f] for f in F}
pn=354/(354+228)  # noise prob from observed fractions (approx)
pg=1-pn

def logP_F_given_S(S):
    S=set(S)
    if not S<=Fset: return -math.inf
    Scells=set().union(*[Fc[s] for s in S]) if S else set()
    lp=0.0
    for wp in windows:
        ov=len(wcells[wp]&Scells)
        if wp in Fset and wp not in S:
            # visible accidental fit: all 6 cells bg; ov are bg due to stamps, rest by chance
            lp+=math.log(pg**(6-ov)+1e-300)
        elif wp not in Fset:
            # must NOT be all-bg
            p_stay=pg**(6-ov)
            lp+=math.log(max(1e-300,1-p_stay))
    return lp

results=[]
for k in range(0,6):
    for S in combinations(F,k):
        lp=logP_F_given_S(S)
        results.append((S,lp))
# priors
import numpy as np
for prior_name,prior in [('uniform K 0..10',lambda k:0.1),('poisson area/40',lambda k:math.exp(-588/40)*(588/40)**k/math.factorial(k))]:
    lps=np.array([lp for S,lp in results])
    pr=np.array([prior(len(S)) for S,lp in results])
    post=np.exp(lps-np.max(lps))*pr
    post/=post.sum()
    order=np.argsort(-post)
    print('==== prior:',prior_name)
    for ix in order[:8]:
        print(f'  K={len(results[ix][0])} S={results[ix][0]} post={post[ix]:.3f}')
